failure_policy.attempts: One response per scheduled batch; no feedback, retries, label repair or adaptive case selection.
failure_policy.denominators: Every scheduled episode and claim remains in its prespecified condition.
invalid_conditions: invalid label, kind, reason or evidence schema
failure_policy.invalid_or_missing_output: Retain literal output; do not repair or retry. Convert all scheduled claims in that batch to unresolved with conversion_failure=true.
failure_policy.primary_agreement: Failure-adjusted agreement: every converted claim is incorrect even when its construction reference is unresolved.
failure_policy.secondary_agreement: Ordinary three-label agreement after unresolved conversion is reported separately.

limitations: Same assistant system as author; not independent annotation or blind model selection.
Exact model identity and sampling settings may be unavailable; use archived run metadata.
Tool-assisted citation integrity; no tool computed model claim labels.
Seventeen episodes share each primary-text context; six share each matched-text or image context. No per-case isolation is claimed.
Images render the same source passages with the populated record unchanged; this is not an extraction accuracy experiment.
Tool restrictions are instructions with worker-reported protocol compliance; complete tool traces were not independently audited, not a technical sandbox.
These are designed fixtures, not a sampled financial deployment population.

model_run.author_model_relationship: Same assistant system as artifact author; fresh contexts do not make this an independent evaluation.
model_run.batch_context: Four fresh primary-text contexts with seventeen episodes each; two fresh matched-text and two fresh image contexts with six episodes each. Episodes within a batch share context.
model_run.live_inference_reproducibility: Exact rerun cannot be guaranteed without an exposed immutable model snapshot and sampling configuration. Archived inputs, outputs and scoring are reproducible offline.
model_run.model_configuration: Inherited parent assistant configuration; no model or reasoning overrides were specified. Immutable snapshot and sampling settings were not exposed.

model_identity_provenance.note: Identity correction only; no new model inference or response revision.

permitted_tool_access: Read named input batch, optionally in segments
View named PNGs for image condition, including repeat views after display issues
Write one literal model response via apply_patch
model_run.scored_outputs: Structured claim labels only; free-text reasons/evidence paths retained but not independently adjudicated.
model_run.tool_activity_evidence: Worker self-reports; complete tool/transport traces were not independently audited.

diagnostics.statistical_unit: scenario family; variants and claims are dependent
